rule_text: Never put more than one primary button in a group of buttons.
notes: Count of primary variant within a button group; tree property.

rule_text: Rarely use more than one primary button per page.
notes: Count of primary variant across a region; soft rule (rarely) so needs a threshold.

rule_text: Danger buttons are used sparingly for destructive actions and typically prompt a confirmation dialog.
notes: Trigger is the danger variant (node-local); companion is a confirmation dialog in the tree. This is the flagship Class B shape.

rule_text: Avoid disabling buttons because it makes them inaccessible to keyboard users.
notes: Detect the disabled prop on a button element.

rule_text: Use the inactive prop when a system error such as an outage prevents the button from performing its action.
notes: Depends on runtime system state; not statically decidable.

rule_text: Use large buttons sparingly; a medium button is appropriate more often than not.
notes: Sparingly is a judgement about frequency and emphasis.

rule_text: Use sentence case for button labels and do not use all-caps.
notes: Casing is detectable but proper nouns and acronyms need semantic judgement.

rule_text: Keep button labels succinct with no line breaks.
notes: Succinct is a content judgement.

rule_text: Show focus styles on keyboard focus and do not remove default focus styles.
notes: Needs the rendered/computed style and focus state.

rule_text: Place primary buttons at the end of a ButtonGroup.
notes: Order of children within a ButtonGroup; tree property.

rule_text: Provide feedback via a dialog or tooltip when a user clicks an inactive button.
notes: Requires runtime interaction behavior.

rule_text: A title is required for all Dialogs and it may be visually hidden.
notes: Overlaps with axe aria-dialog-name; node has an accessible name.

rule_text: The close button is required and may not be visually hidden.
notes: Presence of a visible close control on the dialog node/subtree.

rule_text: Avoid creating a whole page inside a Dialog and prefer single-column layouts.
notes: Whole page is a subjective structural judgement.

rule_text: Avoid side navigation within a Dialog.
notes: Nothing navigational inside a modal; detect nav landmarks in the dialog subtree.

rule_text: Up to two nested Dialogs is acceptable and more than three nested Dialogs is discouraged.
notes: Nesting depth of dialog nodes; tree property.

rule_text: On closing a nested Dialog focus should return to the trigger control.
notes: Focus behavior after interaction; rendered/runtime.

rule_text: Pressing Esc should only close the top-level Dialog.
notes: Keyboard dismissal behavior; runtime.

rule_text: If a Dialog contains a form with unsaved changes the backdrop should not dismiss it.
notes: Detect a form in the dialog subtree plus the backdrop-dismiss config on the dialog node.

rule_text: Dialogs must adjust their design to fit smaller viewports.
notes: Responsive rendering across viewports.

rule_text: Dialogs with input fields should use the full-screen variant on narrow viewports.
notes: Depends on viewport width at render time.

rule_text: Primary actions should be aligned to the right of the footer.
notes: Visual alignment in the rendered footer.

rule_text: Before using an extra-large Dialog consider whether the content belongs on a new page.
notes: Content-fit judgement.

rule_text: A Dialog must support both Esc and close-button dismissal.
notes: Presence of a close button plus an Esc handler on the dialog.

rule_text: Each page should have only one primary button.
notes: Count of primary buttons per page; tree property.

rule_text: Primary buttons should only appear once per screen excluding the header modal and side panel.
notes: Scoped count that excludes specific regions; tree property.

rule_text: When dialogs appear the primary button typically takes focus.
notes: Focus behavior on render.

rule_text: On a form pressing Enter should activate the primary button.
notes: Keyboard behavior; runtime.

rule_text: Secondary buttons can only be used in conjunction with a primary button.
notes: Requires a sibling primary button; tree property.

rule_text: Do not use a secondary button in isolation or for a positive action.
notes: Isolation part is structural; positive-action part leans semantic but the pairing constraint is checkable.

rule_text: Tertiary buttons should not be used in fluid arrangements.
notes: Fluid arrangement is a layout context that is hard to detect statically.

rule_text: Use the danger button for actions with destructive effects such as delete or remove.
notes: Requires knowing the action is destructive; semantic.

rule_text: Destructive actions that are a required or primary step should use the primary danger button style.
notes: Trigger is a semantic destructive+primary action; not fully mechanical.

rule_text: Danger buttons cannot be used in an icon-only form.
notes: Detect danger variant plus icon-only (no visible label) on one node.

rule_text: Do not use two high-emphasis buttons in a button group.
notes: Count of high-emphasis variants within a group; tree property.

rule_text: Do not use tertiary and danger-tertiary buttons together.
notes: Forbidden variant co-occurrence in a group; tree property.

rule_text: Do not use primary and danger-ghost buttons together.
notes: Forbidden variant co-occurrence in a group; tree property.

rule_text: Use a button group when there are two or three actions to consider.
notes: Count of actions in a group; tree property.

rule_text: Buttons in a related group should all be the same width.
notes: Needs computed rendered widths.

rule_text: Use the verb plus noun content formula on buttons except for common actions like Done Close or Cancel.
notes: Part-of-speech and meaning judgement.

rule_text: Use sentence case for all button labels.
notes: Casing plus proper-noun judgement.

rule_text: Do not use only a noun as a button label.
notes: Part-of-speech judgement.

rule_text: Left-align the label in a button even if the button is wide.
notes: Rendered text alignment.

rule_text: Do not truncate a button label.
notes: Truncation shows at render; content/visual.

rule_text: Icons should always appear to the right of the label.
notes: Order of icon vs label within a single button node.

rule_text: Icons used in buttons must be directly related to the action.
notes: Meaning of the icon vs action; semantic.

rule_text: A tooltip is always required for an icon-only button.
notes: Overlaps with axe button-name; icon-only button needs an accessible name.

rule_text: Do not use buttons as navigational elements and use links to move users to a new page.
notes: Requires knowing the action navigates; semantic.

rule_text: Use a modal to confirm user decisions or notify the user of urgent information.
notes: When-to-use is a semantic/context judgement.

rule_text: If a user repeatedly performs a task consider making it completable on the main page instead of a modal.
notes: Usage-frequency judgement.

rule_text: Passive modals contain no actions.
notes: Absence of action buttons in a passive modal subtree.

rule_text: Transactional modals contain a cancel and a primary action button.
notes: Presence of both button roles in the modal subtree.

rule_text: If an action is destructive or irreversible use a transactional danger modal.
notes: Trigger is a semantic destructive action.

rule_text: With two modal buttons place the secondary on the left and the primary on the right.
notes: Order of the two action buttons in the footer; tree property.

rule_text: With three modal buttons each is 25 percent of the modal width and aligned to the right.
notes: Rendered widths and alignment.

rule_text: A danger modal is a transactional modal reserved for destructive or irreversible actions.
notes: Definitional and semantic.

rule_text: Modals should interrupt the workflow only for short and non-frequent tasks.
notes: Task-length and frequency judgement.

rule_text: Write button text in sentence case describing the action it performs.
notes: Casing plus meaning judgement.

rule_text: Align the primary action button to the left edge of your form.
notes: Rendered alignment.

rule_text: Avoid using multiple default buttons on a single page.
notes: Count of default buttons per page; tree property.

rule_text: Only use warning buttons for actions with serious destructive consequences that cannot be easily undone.
notes: Requires judging severity and reversibility; semantic.

rule_text: Do not rely only on the red colour of a warning button to communicate seriousness.
notes: Colour-only signalling shows at render.

rule_text: Make sure the context and button text make clear what will happen when a warning button is selected.
notes: Clarity of wording; content judgement.

rule_text: The white button and background must have a contrast ratio of at least 4.5 to 1.
notes: Contrast is computed from rendered colours; standard axe check.

rule_text: Avoid disabled buttons where possible because they have poor contrast.
notes: Where possible is a judgement even though disabled is detectable.

rule_text: Only use disabled buttons if research shows they make the interface easier to understand.
notes: Conditioned on user research; not mechanical.

rule_text: When a user carries out a serious destructive action include an additional step asking them to confirm it.
notes: Structurally a confirm-step-required rule but the trigger (serious destructive action) is semantic.
